<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="python-api">
<h1>Python API</h1>
<p>The canonical public entry point is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">compile_document</span></code>, which compiles one SSMD
document or explicitly configured plain-text document and returns a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">CompileResult</span></code>.
Its <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span></code> is the immutable, round-trippable renderer-facing <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code>; its
diagnostics describe compilation, and an optional <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparationTrace</span></code> holds compiler
provenance separately. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">UtterancePlanner.plan</span></code> is also supported and returns the
same current <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code> directly.</p>
<p>The Python defaults are repair-first with best-effort spaCy enrichment: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlannerConfig</span></code> uses <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">text_preparation=&quot;auto&quot;</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">renderability_mode=&quot;repair&quot;</span></code>; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">auto</span></code> resolves to SSMD-authoritative preparation for SSMD input and TTSReady/Spokenform for plain text. Explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">spokenform</span></code> on SSMD is a warned legacy mode. Pause-activation policy is not a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlannerConfig</span></code> field, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LinguisticsConfig</span></code> uses local-model <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">auto</span></code>. Auto prefers installed compatible models <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sm</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">md</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lg</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">trf</span></code>, then falls back safely if spaCy or models are unavailable. No model is downloaded.</p>
<p>To require a specific installed model, set <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">require_spacy=True</span></code> and configure its model or tier. The plan records final pass-B token provenance in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">linguistic_runs</span></code>; provider documents are not retained. Set <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">use_spacy=False</span></code> for deterministic opt-out.
V7 <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">token.span</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pos</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tag</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lemma</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">morph</span></code> are the authoritative linguistic context for the exact prepared segment text. Consumers should not retokenize or rerun spaCy. Optional replacement spans are local to final prepared <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">segment.text</span></code>; original spellings are stored as provenance strings, while complete source offsets and preparation maps belong in the optional trace sidecar.</p>
<section id="sentence-segmentation-and-private-topology">
<h2>Sentence segmentation and private topology</h2>
<p>PhraseSplit is an advisory sentence-boundary provider, not an owner of compiler topology. UtterPlan validates each whole proposal batch, maps accepted run-local offsets once into prepared spoken-text coordinates, then recomputes paragraph and sentence indices from parser paragraph events and accepted boundaries. If PhraseSplit fails or returns malformed/incomplete coverage, deterministic conservative fallback preserves the text and emits diagnostics. Automatic cuts that divide provider-aware lexical content are discarded or merged; the final flow-projection token-edge check remains active.</p>
<p>Semicolon and context-safe colon separators, plus optional trusted clause/parenthetical candidates, form private sentence parts. Language, directive, authored-pause, marker, and media cuts subdivide those parts without changing their indices. Exact surface and non-whitespace coverage validation runs in strict and repair renderability modes alike. Parts are not public fields: the compact ordered v7 <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">flow</span></code> serializes canonical boundary kinds at segment edges; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowUnit</span></code> grouping is fixed paragraph-local and independent of renderer chunk choices.</p>
</section>
<section id="canonical-single-document-compiler">
<h2>Canonical single-document compiler</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">compile_document</span></code> is the shared semantic interpretation boundary for independent
consumers. It does not load books, traverse chapters, or manage consumer workspaces.
SSMD header language takes precedence over a fallback; the explicit
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">fallback_language</span></code> keyword is a per-call fallback override, never a forced language.
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlannerConfig.language</span></code> remains required for compatibility and supplies the fallback
when <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">fallback_language</span></code> is omitted. Plain input must have a language fallback.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">utterplan</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">PlannerConfig</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">compile_document</span>

<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">compile_document</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">ssmd_source</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">input_format</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;ssmd&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">config</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">PlannerConfig</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
    <span class="n">trace</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">plan</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">plan</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">plan</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="n">plan</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">trace</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">input_format=&quot;plain&quot;</span></code> only for explicitly configured plain text. A trace
contains explanatory per-unit preparation information but is not serialized into
the plan, is not renderer input, and does not change <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan.plan_id</span></code>. Its source
ranges index SSMD-clean structural text; transformation output ranges index prepared
spoken text, using Python string character offsets.</p>
</section>
<section id="build-and-replan-a-renderplan">
<h2>Build and replan a RenderPlan</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">build_render_plan</span></code> is the shared schema-v7-only projection API. It consumes an
already compiled <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code> and a shared <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">renderplan.RenderProfile</span></code>; it does not
prepare text again or depend on renderer, G2P, or audio packages. Replanning passes
the exact prior RenderPlan and its matching preflight report together:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">renderplan.codec</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">load_plan</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">load_preflight</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">load_profile</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">save_plan</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">utterplan</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">FlowPlan</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">build_render_plan</span>

<span class="n">source</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">FlowPlan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">load</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;chapter.utterplan.toml&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">profile</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">load_profile</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;voice.renderprofile.toml&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">plan</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">build_render_plan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">source</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">profile</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">save_plan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">plan</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;chapter.renderplan.toml&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">previous</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">load_plan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;chapter.renderplan.toml&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">preflight</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">load_preflight</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;chapter.preflight.toml&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">next_plan</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">build_render_plan</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">source</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">profile</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">previous_plan</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">previous</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">preflight</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">preflight</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">save_plan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">next_plan</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;chapter.next.renderplan.toml&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The previous plan and preflight are a required pair. UtterPlan preserves successful
prior partitions and replaces only exact failed speech occurrences. Backend metrics
remain diagnostics supplied by preflight; UtterPlan does not estimate them. Use
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan</span> <span class="pre">render-plan</span> <span class="pre">--explain</span></code> to format the already-built decisions.</p>
<section id="inspect-logical-role-coverage">
<h3>Inspect logical role coverage</h3>
<p>The public role-coverage helpers expose source inventory independently of projection or renderer bindings. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">logical_role_inventory()</span></code> counts explicit role references and speech using the profile default; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">profile_role_coverage()</span></code> compares those requirements with one complete RenderProfile, preserving first-occurrence order for required roles and deterministic sorting for available roles. The returned <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LogicalRoleInventory</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ProfileRoleCoverage</span></code> types separate source inventory from profile coverage. Both functions are available from the package root:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">renderplan.codec</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">load_profile</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">utterplan</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">FlowPlan</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">logical_role_inventory</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">profile_role_coverage</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">assert_profile_role_coverage</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">source</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">FlowPlan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">load</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;chapter.utterplan.toml&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">inventory</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">logical_role_inventory</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">source</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">profile</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">load_profile</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;cast.renderprofile.toml&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">coverage</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">assert_profile_role_coverage</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">source</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">profile</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">inventory</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">explicit_roles</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">inventory</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">explicit_occurrences</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">coverage</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">required_roles</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">coverage</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">available_roles</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">coverage</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">missing_roles</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Empty and audio-only segments do not require a role. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">assert_profile_role_coverage()</span></code> raises the normal <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">renderplan.role.missing</span></code> projection error with all missing role names; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">build_render_plan()</span></code> performs this check before grouping or replanning.</p>
</section>
</section>
<section id="persistable-planning-attempts">
<h2>Persistable planning attempts</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">compile_attempt</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">UtterancePlanner.compile_attempt</span></code> expose a finalized planning
outcome without raising solely because a segment is not renderable. They still raise
for input, configuration, and planning failures. The existing <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">compile_document</span></code>,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">UtterancePlanner.compile</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span></code> APIs remain strict and continue raising
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlanRenderabilityError</span></code> when renderability blocks completion.</p>
<p>Attempts are separate from canonical plans. A blocked attempt retains an inspect-only
candidate draft; it is not a valid <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code> and cannot be loaded by
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.load()</span></code>. Persist it with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlanningAttempt.save()</span></code> and restore it with
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlanningAttempt.load()</span></code>; the attempt TOML schema is
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan.planning-attempt.v1</span></code>, independent of canonical plan schema v7.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">utterplan</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">PlannerConfig</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">compile_attempt</span>

<span class="n">attempt</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">compile_attempt</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;Hello.</span><span class="se">\n\n</span><span class="s2">.</span><span class="se">\n\n</span><span class="s2">World.&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">input_format</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;plain&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">config</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">PlannerConfig</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">renderability_mode</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;strict&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">attempt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">status</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;blocked&quot;</span>
<span class="n">attempt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">save</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;chapter.attempt.toml&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">issue</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">attempt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">renderability</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">issues</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">assessment</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">issue</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">repair_assessment</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">assessment</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">issue</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">segment_id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">assessment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">safe</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">assessment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">action</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">assessment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">blockers</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Repair assessments report the existing conservative options; they do not rewrite
text speculatively. In repair mode, only the planner’s established safe repairs are
applied. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan</span> <span class="pre">inspect-attempt</span> <span class="pre">chapter.attempt.toml</span> <span class="pre">--issues</span></code> shows issues,
source locations, and repair assessments; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--segment</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--unit</span></code> select candidate
topology, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--json</span></code> emits the complete attempt as JSON for inspection.</p>
</section>
<section id="toml-persistence">
<h2>TOML persistence</h2>
<p>Schema v7 is the current semantic contract, while <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.utterplan.toml</span></code> is the canonical persisted format. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.to_toml()</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.from_toml()</span></code> round-trip the current executable plan; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">save()</span></code> writes atomically, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">load()</span></code> accepts TOML only. All normal decode/load and execution paths reject non-v7 plans with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">schema.version_unsupported</span></code>; they never migrate implicitly. Historical inputs retain a separate sequential data-only migration path through v6, but v6-to-v7 refuses with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">migration.recompile_required</span></code> because omitted boundary opportunities cannot be recovered; recompile the original source.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">utterplan</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">FlowPlan</span>

<span class="n">toml_text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_toml</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="n">restored</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">FlowPlan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">from_toml</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">toml_text</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">restored</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="n">plan</span>
<span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">save</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;chapter.utterplan.toml&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">FlowPlan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">load</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;chapter.utterplan.toml&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="n">plan</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.to_dict()</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.from_dict()</span></code> expose the current v7 executable mapping. Normal decoding accepts v7 only; versioned v5/v6 codecs are reachable solely through explicit serialized-data migration. Promotion to v7 requires source recompilation and does not invent boundaries. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan</span> <span class="pre">migrate</span></code> reports that requirement; SSMD source migration remains a separate operation.</p>
</section>
<section id="incremental-batch-compilation">
<h2>Incremental batch compilation</h2>
<p>The public batch API compiles independent requests one at a time, atomically commits each successful plan, and yields an outcome without retaining the plan object. Ordinary per-document read, planning, validation, serialization, and write failures become failed outcomes and processing continues by default. Set <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">fail_fast=True</span></code> to skip later requests after the first failure. Existing files are protected unless <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">force=True</span></code> is explicit. An optional TOML operational report is refreshed after each outcome.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pathlib</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Path</span>

<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">utterplan</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">CompileRequest</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">PlannerConfig</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">compile_to_files</span>

<span class="n">requests</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
    <span class="n">CompileRequest</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="nb">id</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;chapter-1&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">source</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;chapters/one.ssmd&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="n">output</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;plans/one.utterplan.toml&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="n">input_format</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;auto&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">),</span>
    <span class="n">CompileRequest</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="nb">id</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;chapter-2&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">source</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;chapters/two.ssmd&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="n">output</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;plans/two.utterplan.toml&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="n">input_format</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;auto&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">]</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">outcome</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">compile_to_files</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">requests</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">config</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">PlannerConfig</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
    <span class="n">report_path</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;plans/compile-report.toml&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">outcome</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">status</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">outcome</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">source_label</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">outcome</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">output</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The report is operational data, not a semantic plan, and must not be passed to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.load()</span></code>. Unexpected programming and progress-callback errors propagate rather than being converted to document failures.</p>
</section>
<section id="renderplan-batch-projection">
<h2>RenderPlan batch projection</h2>
<p>The shared RenderPlan set contract is owned by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">renderplan</span></code>. Import its types and codecs from that package; use UtterPlan’s batch module only for UtterPlan-specific request, outcome, set-construction, and projection orchestration APIs. Although <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan.renderplan_batch</span></code> retains compatibility re-exports, new consumers should not depend on them.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">renderplan</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">RenderPlanSet</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">RenderPlanSetChapter</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">RenderPlanSetError</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">RenderProfile</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">load_renderplan_set</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">save_renderplan_set</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">utterplan.renderplan_batch</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">RenderRequest</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">new_renderplan_set</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">render_to_files</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">render_to_files()</span></code> projects schema-v7 <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code> inputs; grouping, source mapping, export, and replan logic remain UtterPlan-owned.</p>
</section>
<section id="unified-bundle-services">
<h2>Unified bundle services</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">compile_bundle()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">render_bundle()</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">replan_bundle()</span></code> are the public Python counterparts of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan</span> <span class="pre">bundle</span> <span class="pre">compile|render|replan</span></code>. They accept a canonical <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;name&gt;.ssmd-bundle/</span></code> path and dispatch book or document behavior from its manifest. The CLI delegates to these services, so selection and path-safety rules are shared.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">utterplan</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">compile_bundle</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">replan_bundle</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">render_bundle</span>

<span class="n">compiled</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">compile_bundle</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;novel.ssmd-bundle&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chapters</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;5-17&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">projected</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">render_bundle</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;novel.ssmd-bundle&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">profile</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;narration.renderprofile.toml&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">chapters</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;5-17&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">refined</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">replan_bundle</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;novel.ssmd-bundle&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">variant</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">projected</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">variant</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">chapters</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;5&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">compiled</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exit_code</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="n">projected</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exit_code</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="n">refined</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exit_code</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The compile and render services accept paths and keyword options. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">chapters</span></code> defaults to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&quot;all&quot;</span></code>; book bundles select manifest source numbers, while document bundles accept only <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&quot;all&quot;</span></code>. Rendering requires an explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">profile</span></code>; replanning requires the exact active <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">variant</span></code>. Options include output/report paths, force and fail-fast behavior, compile planning settings, and optional progress/start callbacks. Services do not print.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">BundleCompileResult</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">BundleRenderResult</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">BundleReplanResult</span></code> expose the resolved bundle, manifest-declared kind, selected item IDs, per-item outcomes, generated paths, reports, and exit status. Their start records provide resolved configuration to optional callbacks. Invalid or unsafe shared requests raise <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">BundleServiceError</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">BundleReplanError</span></code>; item-level failures are reported in result outcomes. The package also exports manifest loader, selector, item-path, result, start, and callback types for integrations that need to inspect dispatch results.</p>
</section>
<section id="planner-progress-callbacks">
<h2>Planner progress callbacks</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">UtterancePlanner.plan</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">UtterancePlanner.compile</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">compile_document</span></code> accept an optional keyword-only <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">on_progress</span></code> callback. It receives typed <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlannerProgressEvent</span></code> objects synchronously in the planner thread. Progress is operational only: it is not added to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlannerConfig</span></code> or the plan, and enabling a callback does not change plan identity or serialization.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">utterplan</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">PlannerConfig</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">PlannerProgressEvent</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">UtterancePlanner</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">report</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">event</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">PlannerProgressEvent</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-&gt;</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">event</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">kind</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;run.started&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span>
            <span class="n">event</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">phase</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">event</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">pass_index</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">event</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">language</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">event</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">provider</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">event</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">model</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="p">)</span>


<span class="n">planner</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">UtterancePlanner</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">PlannerConfig</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="n">plan</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">planner</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">plan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">on_progress</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">report</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The phase events cover parsing, source analysis, preparation, spoken analysis, segmentation, and finalization. Each provider run reports <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">run.started</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">run.completed</span></code>; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">completed</span></code> counts fully completed runs and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">total</span></code> is the number of runs in that phase. When a local spaCy model is actually loaded, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">model.started</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">model.completed</span></code> identify its language, provider, and resolved model. Cached models produce no load events. Events contain primitive metadata only, never spaCy pipelines or documents.</p>
<p>Callbacks should be lightweight. An exception raised by a callback propagates to the caller and can be used to stop planning. A provider invocation such as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pipeline(text)</span></code> is one opaque work unit: events report its start and completion but do not claim smooth percentages or internal progress. If spoken-text preparation leaves the linguistic input unchanged, the planner can reuse source analysis; the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">spoken_analysis</span></code> phase events expose <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">details[&quot;reused&quot;]</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">True</span></code> and no provider-run events are emitted for that reuse. Identity preparation also reports <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source_analysis</span></code> as skipped (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">details[&quot;skipped&quot;]</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">True</span></code>) because it does not use source analyses; the single actual provider pass runs as logical pass 2.</p>
</section>
<section id="ssmd-input-and-semantic-plan">
<h2>SSMD input and semantic plan</h2>
<p>The SSMD parser accepts dialect 0.9 only. Select SSMD explicitly for unversioned canonical fragments with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlannerConfig(document_format=&quot;ssmd&quot;)</span></code>. Older SSMD source must be migrated with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ssmd</span> <span class="pre">migrate</span> <span class="pre">FILE</span> <span class="pre">--to</span> <span class="pre">0.9</span></code>; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">migrate_plan_data</span></code> operates on serialized plan mappings, while <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan</span> <span class="pre">migrate</span></code> imports legacy plans, not source documents.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlannerConfig.document_format</span></code> defaults to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&quot;plain&quot;</span></code>, so SSMD syntax is never inferred for an ordinary Python string. Set it to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&quot;ssmd&quot;</span></code> for SSMD documents or fragments. There is no compile-time pause activation setting: authored SSMD breaks are represented as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PauseIntent</span></code>, while automatic safe boundaries remain separate <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">boundary_before</span></code> / <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">boundary_after</span></code> values. Consumers choose how to realize either fact without changing plan identity.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">utterplan</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">PlannerConfig</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">compile_document</span>

<span class="n">ssmd_source</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;&quot;&quot;---</span>
<span class="s2">ssmd_version: &quot;0.9&quot;</span>
<span class="s2">title: API example</span>
<span class="s2">language: en-us</span>
<span class="s2">---</span>
<span class="s2">Hello [world]{emphasis=&quot;strong&quot;}.</span>
<span class="s2">&quot;&quot;&quot;</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">compile_document</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">ssmd_source</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">input_format</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;ssmd&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">config</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">PlannerConfig</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
    <span class="n">trace</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">plan</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">plan</span>
<span class="n">segment</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">flow</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">segments</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">document</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ssmd_version</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;0.9&quot;</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">trace</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="kc">None</span>  <span class="c1"># source spans/diagnostics are sidecar data</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">segment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">directives</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">emphasis</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">document</span></code> record retains compact portable document information. Effective directives and pause intents live on their owning flow segments. Compiler-only source spans and preparation coordinate maps remain in the optional trace. See the <a class="reference internal" href="../coordinate-spaces/"><span class="doc std std-doc">coordinate-space contract</span></a> and <a class="reference internal" href="../consumer-guide/"><span class="doc std std-doc">consumer guide</span></a> for renderer responsibilities.</p>
</section>
<section id="flow-segments-and-local-tokens">
<h2>Flow segments and local tokens</h2>
<p>A <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code> stores ordered <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowUnit</span></code> objects. Each unit owns its ordered segments, so consumers do not join plan-global IDs. Token offsets use Python-character coordinates local to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">segment.text</span></code>:</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowUnit</span></code> grouping is always paragraph-local; it is not a renderer-chunk selection. Each <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowSegment</span></code> carries <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">boundary_before</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">boundary_after</span></code> tuples of canonical <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">BoundaryKind</span></code> values (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">clause</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sentence</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">paragraph</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">parenthetical</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice_change</span></code>). These are safe downstream cut opportunities, not commands or pause durations. Authored SSMD breaks live independently in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_before</span></code> / <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_after</span></code>, so both may coexist at one edge. A segment is not necessarily one TTS request.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">unit</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">flow</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">segment</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">unit</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">segments</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">token</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">segment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">tokens</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">surface</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">segment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">token</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">start</span> <span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">token</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">end</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">segment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">language</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">surface</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">token</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lemma</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">token</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">pos</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Authored pause intent is local to the segment edge: it is an authored strength or exact timed break (including explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">none</span></code>), not an automatic sentence/parenthetical boundary. Downstream consumers choose whether to realize authored pauses natively, automatically, or manually. Heading levels and marker names are already localized to the segments and units that own them. Linguistic token views do not expose engine-token IDs or token counts.</p>
</section>
<section id="audio-media-segments">
<h2>Audio/media segments</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">AudioDirective</span></code> is already part of the public API. Inspect it on the segment; its
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">src</span></code> is an opaque renderer input, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">segment.text</span></code> is optional spoken fallback:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">segment</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">flow</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">segments</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span>
<span class="n">audio</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">segment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">directives</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">audio</span>
<span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">audio</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">src</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># Resolve externally; do not parse SFX URI syntax here.</span>
    <span class="n">fallback_text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">segment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">text</span>  <span class="c1"># May be &quot;&quot; when no spoken fallback exists.</span>
<span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">spoken_text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">segment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">text</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Each SSMD audio annotation is represented by one audio-bearing segment. Separate
occurrences may have the same <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">src</span></code>; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">segment.text</span></code> is not the media identity and
consumers do not need to inspect raw SSMD annotations to find media.</p>
</section>
<section id="planner-configuration">
<h2>Planner configuration</h2>
</section>
<section id="planning-and-plan-records">
<h2>Planning and plan records</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">UtterancePlan</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlanSegment</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlanUnit</span></code> remain legacy compiler/migration models. Fresh compilation returns <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code>; renderers should use only the v7 flow contract.</p>
</section>
<section id="renderer-neutral-ssmd-directives">
<h2>Renderer-neutral SSMD directives</h2>
<p>The v7 public model exposes <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.flow</span></code>, compact <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">document</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">linguistics</span></code> records, and local segment fields for text, language, canonical boundary opportunities, authored pause intent, directives, markers, headings, and linguistic tokens. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowSegment.directives</span></code> contains typed semantics after scope and voice-default resolution. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TokenView</span></code> offsets address only its owning segment’s text; provider documents are not retained. See the <a class="reference internal" href="../consumer-guide/"><span class="doc std std-doc">consumer guide</span></a> for renderer responsibilities.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">TokenView</span></code> carries optional lemma, POS, tag, and morph facts. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LinguisticProvenance</span></code> identifies the analysis provider and model without retaining provider state. Exact raw source is stored in the optional <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.source</span></code> record, introduced in v6 and retained in v7, which may be absent on migrated v5 plans. Source spans and preparation coordinate maps remain available only in an optional <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreparationTrace</span></code> sidecar.</p>
</section>
<section id="errors">
<h2>Errors</h2>
<p>Planning and loading failures derive from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan.UtterPlanError</span></code>. Important
public subclasses include <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ConfigurationError</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlanningError</span></code>,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlanFormatError</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlanValidationError</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">UnsupportedSchemaError</span></code>.
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlanMigrationError</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">MigrationPathError</span></code> report migration-specific failures. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">UnsupportedSchemaError</span></code> remains reserved for a schema newer than the installed package understands.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlanRenderabilityError</span></code> presents the same actionable source and spoken context as the CLI, including safe repair opportunities, semantic blockers, and a next action. Safe punctuation-only repair is the default; choose <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlannerConfig(renderability_mode=&quot;strict&quot;)</span></code> when a caller needs to reject every repair opportunity. Symbols are never assigned guessed pronunciations.</p>
</section>
<section id="schema-migration-api">
<h2>Schema migration API</h2>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">utterplan</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">FlowPlan</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">MigrationResult</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">MigrationStep</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSIONS</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">migrate_plan_data</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">result</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">MigrationResult</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">migrate_plan_data</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">serialized_mapping</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">target_version</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="n">CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION</span>
<span class="n">plan</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">FlowPlan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">from_dict</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">data</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Migration functions operate on plain JSON-compatible mappings and never mutate their input. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">MigrationResult</span></code> records source and target versions, sequential steps, and source and target plan IDs. Current-schema migration is an exact no-op.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
